title: British Beauty Council names Bridgerton actor Golda Rosheuvel ambassador
summary: Golda Rosheuvel, who plays Queen Charlotte in Netflix's period drama Bridgerton, has been appointed the new face of the British Beauty Council, working with the industry body to help raise awareness of the social and cultural value of UK beauty
